_comment: Provenance manifest for every potential matrix shipped in this package.
tests/regression/test_shipped_potentials.py enforces it: a potential-shaped CSV in
this folder with no entry fails, and any entry with a recipe must reproduce its file
bit-for-bit. Add an entry in the same commit that adds a matrix.
source: 'contact-maps' | 'structure-dir' -> reproducible by CLI and checked;
command: the CLI subcommand of the recipe; defaults to 'derive-potential'.
known_unresolved: historical files whose provenance cannot be recovered. The suite fails on any source='unknown' entry NOT listed here, so a new unprovenanced matrix cannot be added silently.

classic.description: Nat Comput Sci 2022 derivation; the historical default loaded by tcren.potential.tcren().

tcren2.description: TCRen2: the default TCR:peptide potential. Redundancy-balanced derivation over the fully annotated alpha-beta TCR:pMHC crystals of Native2026 -- 362 of 374; derive-potential admits nothing else, by design -- each structure weighted by the mean of 1/(structures sharing its epitope) and 1/(structures sharing its CDR3a/CDR3b pair).

mj1996.description: Miyazawa & Jernigan 1996 contact energies e_ij, used on the presentation interfaces. Hand transcribed; five of 210 unique pairs (M-V, D-M, E-M, H-R, A-P) differ from AAindex3 MIYS960101 by 0.04-0.28, correlating at 0.99978. Left untouched and pinned by tests/unit/test_aaindex.py; aaindex('MIYS960101') is the curated alternative.
mj1996.reference: Miyazawa S, Jernigan RL. J Mol Biol 1996;256:623-644.

mj_keskin.description: Two matrices in one file, both identified against AAindex3 on 2026-08-29 at 400/400 cells exactly. 'MJ' is MIYS990106 (Miyazawa-Jernigan 1999), NOT 1985 or 1996; 'Keskin' is KESO980101, the solvent-mediated interfacial form. Re-verify with tcren.potential.identify().
mj_keskin.reference: Miyazawa S, Jernigan RL. Proteins 1999;34:49-68 (AAindex3 MIYS990106); Keskin O, Bahar I, Badretdinov AY, Ptitsyn OB, Jernigan RL. Protein Sci 1998;7:2578-2586 (AAindex3 KESO980101).

bt1999.description: Betancourt-Thirumalai B matrix: Miyazawa-Jernigan re-referenced with Thr as the reference solvent, so every Thr entry is exactly 0.00. Parsed from the AAindex3 record, never retyped.
bt1999.reference: Betancourt MR, Thirumalai D. Protein Sci 1999;8:361-369.
